_note: Required fields: id. baseEntity (default minecraft:zombie) is the vanilla mob used to spawn it (visuals/hitbox/sounds) — it is summoned with NoAI:1, so it neither chases nor moves on its own, but it acts by itself on its turn (TurnManager) if turn mode is active.
name: Goblin

_note: An attack with appliesEffect leaves the target taking damage each turn (the same StatusEffect that TurnManager.tickEffects already applies at the start of each of their turns) — turns counts turn-mode turns, not real ticks.
name: Giant Spider

_note: abilities_special: the monster's special spells/attacks (a saving throw instead of an attack roll) — the same field as the player's "attacks", but with a fixed saveDc instead of a computed one. It can also carry appliesEffect.
name: Fire Mage

_note: baseEntity accepts ANY registered EntityType, including one from another mod: if you have the Easy NPC mod (easy_npc, unmodified) installed, 'easy_npc:humanoid' works the same as 'minecraft:zombie' above — it is summoned with NoAI:1 and the dndsheets rules apply to it with no extra code, only the base model/skin changes.
name: Bandit
